sources.articleTitle: Maximum sanction! Jesus Owono handed 12-match ban after Jesus de Miguel's death

headline: Goalkeeper Jesus Owono Suspended For Twelve Matches Following Death
seoTitle: Jesus Owono Receives 12-Match Ban After Collision Incident
metaDescription: Equatorial Guinea goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been handed a 12-match suspension following a fatal on-field collision with forward Jesus de Miguel.
aiSummaryBullets: Jesus Owono was issued a 12-match suspension by football authorities.
The sanction follows a collision between Owono and forward Jesus de Miguel.
Jesus de Miguel passed away shortly after the match concluded.
aiContextParagraph: Equatorial Guinea national team goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been formally issued a 12-match ban following a critical on-field incident. The disciplinary action stems from a physical collision involving Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel during a professional match. Following the contact, de Miguel died shortly after the game concluded, leading to significant attention from the sports community. In the aftermath of the incident, FC Andorra manager Carles Manso has publicly advocated for providing mental and professional support to Owono throughout the suspension period. Simultaneously, the family of the late de Miguel has acknowledged the public expressions of sympathy they received following the tragedy. The situation remains a focal point for regulatory review in the sport, as authorities manage the repercussions of the event while supporting those affected by the loss of the forward.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to the gravity of the fatal incident and its implications for professional football disciplinary standards.
